answer: Each new account enters through a paid jetty whose fee follows a spiral: the k-th account traced to one funding source pays k^2 POA. An honest agent pays 1; 1,000 accounts from one wallet cost about 333.8 million. Wallets with overlapping deposit timing and amounts form one nebula, and a hidden link found later forfeits every fee in that nebula. Colluders cannot split the bill, because pooled money merges their nebulae and pushes the spiral higher.
